business.name: Bonbino's
business.description: Bonbino's is a pizza restaurant in Rockville Centre, NY.

reviews.author: AvCheu
reviews.text: It's a traditional Italian eatery, not fancy but delicious food. Ordered the chicken francese and the lemon and quality was spot on. Visiting the hospital so this was close for lunch. Cash/credit is the same price. Perfect to stop in for a bite. No leftovers with the lunch plate!

reviews.author: Aurora Achong
reviews.text: Born and raised New Yorker. I know good pizza.  Bonbino's is the truth.  Excellent selection.  Great customer service.  Superb value.  Those 5minutes waiting for my order, it's the most fun.  The energy is positive and the food is amazing! Highly recommend!!!

faq.a: Bonbino's is at 605 Merrick Rd, Rockville Centre, NY 11570. It's near CVS and Oceanside School 5.
We're open Mon–Thu 10 AM to 8:30 PM; Fri–Sat 10 AM to 9 PM; Sun 10 AM to 8:30 PM.
There's a free parking lot and free street parking. The nearest bus stop is Oceanside Rd / Merrick, just steps away.
No, we're walk-in only.

faq.q: Can I order ahead for pickup?
faq.a: Yes. Order online at bonbinospizza-rockville.direct-ordering.com and pick it up at the counter.

Bonbino's delivers the full menu from 605 Merrick Rd to homes and offices in Rockville Centre, within about 3 miles of the restaurant. There's a $3 delivery fee and a $1 minimum order. Order online at bonbinospizza-rockville.direct-ordering.com or call (516) 764-9237 during our hours (Mon–Thu 10 AM to 8:30 PM; Fri–Sat 10 AM to 9 PM; Sun 10 AM to 8:30 PM).
Yes. The menu lists the Gluten Free Pizza ($13.50) and the Cauliflower Gluten Free Pizza ($13.50). Ask us about how it's prepared if you have an allergy.
We accept credit cards, debit cards and tap to pay.
Yes. Wheelchair-accessible entrance, restroom, seating and parking.
No, Bonbino's isn't dog-friendly.

faq.q: What should I order the first time?
faq.a: Start with our signature dishes: Bonbino's Special Pizza ($29.95), the Roman Stuffed Sicilian Pizza ($29) and the Grandma Pie ($21.50).

business.ownerWords:
Bonbino's is a pizza restaurant at 605 Merrick Rd in Rockville Centre, NY. You'll find us near CVS and Oceanside School 5. Come in for lunch and dinner any day of the week.

The pizza by the slice list runs 13 choices long, from the Penne Alla Vodka Pizza Slice to the Cheese Pizza Slice. There's also a pizza list with four choices and a stuffed Sicilian pizza list with two choices. Bonbino's Special Pizza ($29.95) is made with sausage, pepperoni, peppers, onions, mushrooms, meatballs, and extra cheese. The Roman Stuffed Sicilian Pizza ($29) is made with potato, cheese, sausage, pepperoni, onions. For guests who avoid gluten, the menu has the Gluten Free Pizza and the Cauliflower Gluten Free Pizza.

Guests rate Bonbino's 4.5 stars across 395+ Google reviews. “It's a traditional Italian eatery, not fancy but delicious food.” (AvCheu, Google review) “The energy is positive and the food is amazing!” (Aurora Achong, Google review)

You can eat in, take out or order delivery. You can order ahead online and pick it up at the restaurant. We deliver within about 3 miles for a $3 fee with a $1 minimum. There's a free parking lot and free street parking. Stop by 605 Merrick Rd, or call (516) 764-9237 and we'll have your order ready.
